notes.title: A new look
changes: The client has a new look throughout: new type, brass-edged panels, and menus that move.
The match HUD is redrawn and animated, with tooltips that show an ability's real numbers and a stats panel beside your portrait.
The scoreboard, shop, Collection, Profile, Settings and Match History are redrawn to match.
Profile banners show the regions of Veyra.
Units are drawn from the server's motions rather than its positions, so they move smoothly and stop where they stop, and your orders answer at once.

notes.title: Smoother movement
changes: Vanguards glide between the server's updates instead of stepping, so movement no longer rubber-bands.
Your own Vanguard answers your move orders at once, ahead of the server's word.
Each move order's marker stays with the Vanguard it was given to.
The launcher shows an update's true download size, and keeps an install log for troubleshooting.

notes.title: The Crucible rebuilt
changes: The Crucible is rebuilt, and its river ripples where Vanguards wade through it.
Every Vanguard's abilities have new animation and effects.
Raska's thrown bike flies as the bike itself.
